title: Responsive and Nimble Driving Feel
summary: Most sampled feedback describes the G60 as responsive, nimble, and composed to drive, though a few fragments conflict or are too context-limited to interpret cleanly.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise responsive handling, nimble feel, composed road manners, and an engaging driving character.

negative.summary: The negative review complains that console buttons are hard to find and not very responsive in operation rather than criticizing driving dynamics.

undetermined.summary: The undetermined review describes a calm, composed driving impression but does not make its evaluative sentiment clear enough to classify confidently.

limitations: Several sampled positive-assigned fragments contain wording that appears negative or comparative out of context, so the cluster may include some annotation or excerpting ambiguity.
The negative example is about control responsiveness of console buttons, which is a different aspect from vehicle handling and driving responsiveness.
Examples are limited and sentiment-stratified, so they should not be treated as representative of all G60 feedback on this topic.
